# select_orthogonal_anchors { #dyf.select_orthogonal_anchors }

```python
select_orthogonal_anchors(
    embeddings,
    k,
    seed_indices=None,
    candidate_indices=None,
    use_bridges=True,
    global_num_bits=12,
    seed=42,
)
```

Select k maximally spread anchors using greedy farthest-point sampling.

Achieves ~87% of full-bridge recall with ~22% of anchors by eliminating
redundancy in anchor placement.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type                                             | Description                                              | Default    |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| embeddings        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)         | Normalized embeddings (n_points, dim)                    | _required_ |
| k                 | [int](`int`)                                     | Number of anchors to select                              | _required_ |
| seed_indices      | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| None | Initial seed points (default: super connectors)          | `None`     |
| candidate_indices | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| None | Pool to select from (default: bridges or all points)     | `None`     |
| use_bridges       | [bool](`bool`)                                   | If True and candidate_indices is None, use bridge points | `True`     |
| global_num_bits   | [int](`int`)                                     | LSH bits for bridge detection                            | `12`       |
| seed              | [int](`int`)                                     | Random seed                                              | `42`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                                  |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
|        | [OrthogonalAnchorResult](`dyf.rag.OrthogonalAnchorResult`) | OrthogonalAnchorResult with selected indices |
